note: quince#80 half two: issues referenced by open PRs are watched AUTOMATICALLY, with no declaration. The ruling is explicit that half one alone is insufficient — a session must not have to remember to declare the issue its own PR is for. `via=referenced` is on every event, because the session never asked for this issue and an unexplained event about one it did not declare is the kind of signal a reader learns to ignore. Here #64 is watched purely because an open PR names it, and it gains a comment. Note the DISCOVERY signal is measured, not assumed: over 25 PRs in this repo, closingIssuesReferences alone covers 10 and the title `#N` convention covers 22, so the union is what this rests on — see the tick() comment. The decisive case was quince#87 itself, whose body says 'Closes half one of #80' and whose link data is therefore empty.
